issues.description: is_registered mutation on shared TritonLoraConfig creates a data race and silent correctness bug
issues.detail: lora_config.is_registered is flipped to True on the shared metadata object after the first request constructs the inputs. Two concurrent requests for the same LoRA can both see is_registered=False, or one can race ahead, mark it registered, and the other skips weights before TRT-LLM has actually cached them. Async FastAPI handlers will hit this. State belongs on the backend, not on a config object passed by reference.

issues.description: _get_lora_config returns None but the type signature claims TritonLoraConfig
issues.detail: The function is annotated `-> TritonLoraConfig` yet returns None when lora_name is None or lora_configs is missing. Either the annotation is a lie or every caller is about to NoneType-attribute-error. Pick one. Also model_metadata.get(model_name) can return None and is dereferenced without a check.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: feature, exception-trace logging, and gitignore tweak crammed into one diff
issues.detail: Adding traceback prints to chat/completions/embeddings routers is unrelated debug scaffolding. The gitignore entry for tensorrtllm_mistral_models is a developer-local crumb. Split: one patch for TRT-LLM LoRA, one for error-logging policy if it stays. Reviewing three things at once wastes the maintainer's time.

issues.description: Stray print(f"backend: {backend}") left in hot path
issues.detail: This is debug output that escaped review. It fires for every LoRA entry on every model load. Delete it. Same for the traceback.format_exc() print inside the except in _parse_lora_configs — use the logger, not stdout, and don't swallow the exception while still printing it.

issues.description: task_id assignment is global across repos and not stable across reloads
issues.detail: lora_task_id starts at 1 and increments per-entry across all repo paths in iteration order. Dictionary iteration order plus multiple repos plus reload-on-config-change means the same LoRA name can land on a different task_id between restarts, busting TRT-LLM's cache and potentially colliding with task ids set by other clients. Derive the id from something stable (hash of name, or let the backend assign).

issues.description: Return type annotation says List[tuple[str, str]] but function returns List[TritonLoraConfig]
issues.detail: Signature lies. Fix to `Optional[List[TritonLoraConfig]]`. Small thing, but the whole point of the refactor was to stop pretending LoRA metadata is just a string — the annotation should reflect that.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The feature is reasonable and the refactor from lora_names to TritonLoraConfig is the right shape, but the patch ships with a concurrency bug (mutating is_registered on a shared config object from async handlers), a lying return-type annotation, an inconsistent _get_lora_config signature, and debug prints left in. It also bundles unrelated traceback-logging changes across three routers and a developer-local .gitignore entry — that's three patches pretending to be one. Fix the race (state belongs on the backend or behind a lock), stabilize task_id assignment, delete the prints, split the diff, and resubmit.
